generatedProse.practice-connection:
From here, rigour and ethics are things you practise in every piece of research you undertake. Each ethics application, each dataset you protect, each decision you can account for, is this habit at work. The habit to keep is simple: design your research ethically, handle its data responsibly, and keep the thread of integrity intact from proposal to submission.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever work gathers evidence, is held to a standard, and must be defended, the people whose work carries weight are the ones whose integrity can be shown, not just asserted. The discipline you have just practised is one you will use long after you graduate.
